mapper.sql: id, refund_no, order_no, user_id, type, amount, reason, images, status, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `refund_request` (refund_no, order_no, user_id, type, amount, reason, images, status) VALUES (#{refundNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{images}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `refund_request` WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM `refund_request` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `refund_request` SET status = #{status}, audit_remark = #{remark}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status = 0
